classification.difficultyReason: Interpret matching side ticks to infer missing lengths, choose a rectangular decomposition or subtraction, and combine algebraic areas; only the first shape supplies a decomposition line.

content.prompt: Write a simplified expression for the area of the following composite shapes.

spec.description: Unfilled rectilinear shape with a lower-right cut-out, four dimension arrows and a red dashed horizontal decomposition line.
spec.mathematics: The upper rectangle has height 2x and width 3y+4y. The lower-left rectangle has height x and width 3y. The dashed segment runs from the left boundary to the inner corner.
spec.answerVisibility: All dimensions and the decomposition line are permanent student givens; no area answer is shown.

answer.worked:
The upper rectangle has width $3y+4y=7y$. Add the two rectangular areas.
$$\begin{align*}A&=(2x)(7y)+(x)(3y)\\A&=14xy+3xy\\A&=17xy\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Unfilled stepped shape with a raised upper-left section. Single ticks match the short top edge and downward step; double ticks match the inner horizontal edge and right outer edge.
spec.mathematics: The short top edge and step are a. The inner horizontal edge and right vertical edge are 3a. The lower rectangle therefore has width 4a and height 3a, with an additional a by a square.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the source labels a and 3a and both equality-tick pairs are visible; inferred lengths and the area answer are withheld.

answer.worked:
The matching ticks give a step height of $a$ and a right-hand height of $3a$. The lower rectangle has width $a+3a=4a$; the raised section is an $a\times a$ square.
$$\begin{align*}A&=(4a)(3a)+(a)(a)\\A&=12a^2+a^2\\A&=13a^2\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Unfilled rectilinear shape with a lower-right rectangular cut-out. Full top and left edges are labelled 10x and 9y; arrows identify cut-out width 2x and depth y.
spec.mathematics: Subtract a 2x by y rectangular cut-out from a 10x by 9y outer rectangle. The schematic silhouette follows the source rather than imposing an unstated scale.
spec.answerVisibility: All four source dimensions remain visible; no inferred dimensions or area answer are supplied.

answer.worked:
Subtract the cut-out area from the area of the full rectangle.
$$\begin{align*}A&=(10x)(9y)-(2x)(y)\\A&=90xy-2xy\\A&=88xy\end{align*}$$
